task_summary: Make the GPS-out dead-reckoning engine rock-solid across every route + bound the learned-velocity regressor safe-fail for production

steps.title: Map GPS-out engine paths & wrong-route handling
steps.description: Building off the existing correctness audit, read ONLY the GPS-out dead-reckoning path in the repo (EkfOrchestrator, degraded_mode, gps_degradation_detector, station_association, route_geometry, reroute_policy) file:line grounded. The with-GPS app is out of scope. Enumerate exactly what the engine does when GPS is absent/degraded: cold-start underground (no init fix), wrong-route/wrong-direction while blacked out (silent clamp), reroute suppressed offline, blackout entry/exit reacquisition transients, station snap under inflated sigma. Deliver a repo-grounded GPS-out correctness doc stating the safe-fail behavior each case needs.

steps.title: SOTA sweep on learned inertial velocity
steps.description: arXiv sweep as of July 2026 on learned inertial velocity/odometry (TLIO, RoNIN, GNIO, MosaicIMU, and newer) and sim-to-real transfer + virtual-IMU (CROMOSim-style). Extract the standard protocol for verifying a synth-trained model works on real data, and the circularity-avoidance techniques. Deliver a SOTA doc + a concrete circularity-breaking verification protocol for our regressor.

steps.title: Fetch real multi-city metro topology
steps.description: Via OSM/Overpass, fetch rail line geometry + station nodes for several metro networks (e.g. Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, London, NYC, Tokyo) to capture the real distribution of route topology (stop counts, inter-station spacing, curvature, line length, underground fraction).

steps.title: Build diverse route corpus + gold s(t)
steps.description: Reusing the existing synthesizer + journey composer, generate a large corpus of journeys sampled from the real topology distributions, EACH containing GPS-out segment(s) of varied length/placement (the regime that matters). Span stop-count, spacing, curvature, gradient, blackout-vs-target position, surface/underground mix, transfers, carry/phone domain randomization. Gold arc-length s(t) + station arrival times.

steps.title: Run EKF+alarm across the corpus (4 modes)
steps.description: Run the existing fixed EKF + mode-aware alarm evaluator across the whole route corpus in all four modes, focused on the GPS-out window. Report the DISTRIBUTION of lead-error and the harmful-late-fire rate per route family, not point hit-rates.

steps.title: Adversarial worst-case route search
steps.description: Actively search route-geometry space for the configuration that most stresses the alarm (longest blackout vs target position, tightest stop spacing, worst gradient/curvature). Determine whether worst-case failures are safe-side (early) or harmful (late); this is the falsification test behind any 'any-route' claim.

steps.title: Uncertainty-aware velocity fusion
steps.description: Wrap the learned velocity in a calibrated prediction interval (conformal/quantile) and fuse the INTERVAL (inflated vel_var when uncertain) into the EKF, so out-of-distribution regressor output inflates position sigma rather than injecting a confident wrong speed.

steps.title: Verify OOD fails safe (early not late)
steps.description: Construct out-of-distribution stress cases (phone/carry/motion the regressor never saw, degraded vibration) and confirm the uncertainty-aware fusion degrades to early-fire / wide-sigma rather than late-fire. Quantify the harmful-late-fire rate with vs without the safe-fail wrapper.

steps.title: Update report, spec & product-intent doc
steps.description: Fold the any-route results, worst-case findings, SOTA protocol, and safe-fail architecture into the robustness report and the sim-gated Dart port spec. Write a focused GPS-out real-world-factors note (decision-centric + safe-fail framing, plus the wrong-route/cold-start-underground handling the engine needs since GPS can't rescue it). State explicitly what is now guaranteed (directional safe-fail, broad route coverage) and what still requires real ride #2.

desired_outputs: Repo-grounded GPS-out engine correctness doc (cold-start underground, wrong-route/wrong-direction while blacked out, reacquisition transients) with the safe-fail behavior each needs
Learned-velocity SOTA-as-of-July-2026 research doc + circularity-breaking verification protocol
Multi-city real-route-topology corpus (OSM) + any-route EKF+alarm robustness result across all 4 modes with the distribution of lead-error, focused on the GPS-out window
Adversarial worst-case route search: the route geometry that most stresses the GPS-out alarm, and whether its failures are safe-side (early) or harmful (late)
Uncertainty-aware / conformal velocity fusion that makes out-of-distribution regressor behavior fail SAFE (early fire), tested in sim
Updated robustness report + Dart port spec incorporating any-route GPS-out results and the safe-fail architecture

feasibility.rationale: Scope sharpened to the GPS-out dead-reckoning engine (the with-GPS app is fine apart from wrong-route handling, which is in scope here because GPS can't rescue it when out). A true 'deterministic guarantee on any route' is not achievable from n=1 real ride — no simulation certifies a field hit-rate. What IS delivered, building on the existing engineering: (1) far broader coverage by generating GPS-out journeys from REAL multi-city metro topology, (2) adversarial worst-case route search to falsify rather than cherry-pick, (3) a safe-fail architecture bounding the harmful direction (late fire) even when the learned velocity is out-of-distribution. The regressor's circularity (synthesizer vibration is speed-driven) still can't be fully excluded until real ride #2; the uncertainty-aware fusion mitigates by degrading safe rather than claiming the regressor is verified.
